note: PRISM M3 class masks of the Covenant and the Marines: recipes only (Tier 0), in class_mask_recipes.json's format (class_masks.py --recipes; P-auto bone groups, T tiebreaks, P-paint polygons, expect gates). The overlay ships the two-class channel rules of overlay_characters.json now; when a shader's mask is built and the overlay names it (class_mask), its slots become these. 'extract': the map the model is in when it is not b30. 'status' and 'pending' are notes for what the class masks or the classes cannot do yet; class_masks.py ignores them. 'mask_wins' (with the overlay entry's class_mask_wins): the mask's slots A, C and D are kept over the rule, which decides A against B over the mask's B alone; 'keep_plate' tags the rule's plate, closed, as slot A; 'plate_tiebreak' gives a class inside the plate by colour.
